answers.core: Would not be possible if not a core feature.
answers.workaround:
The easiest workaround is to just define a function.

Parent class:
```gdscript
class_name ParentClass

var my_value: String

func set_my_value(new_my_value: String):
    my_value = new_my_value

    # do some stuff...
```

Child class:
```gdscript
class_name ChildClass
extends ParentClass

func set_my_value(new_my_value: String):
    super(new_my_value)

    # do even more stuff...
```
